free_tier.stated: free software, no hosted lane: the Open Source Edition is Apache 2.0 with no licence fee and is built from source, and the Enterprise Edition image is free for individuals; cloud.drone.io is not accepting new registrations

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: there is no hosted service to cap

interface_detail: a server and one or more runners that the user installs; a runner is a standalone daemon that polls the server for pipelines, and the server signs users in through a forge such as GitHub, GitLab, Gitea or Bitbucket
tooling: the user installs and runs the drone-server (the Enterprise Edition image from Docker Hub, or the Open Source Edition built from source with the oss build tag) and one or more runner daemons on a rented or free machine
chaining: use Woodpecker instead; it is the maintained fork of the same design

limits.value: no hosted tier exists, so the path is a self-hosted deployment

reliability_note: cloud.drone.io is not accepting new registrations, with no target date to reopen (vendor support reply, April 2022); its sign-in still answers and hands off to GitHub. The vendor keeps Drone as a snapshot branch of harness/harness and presents Harness Open Source as its next generation
confidence_note: the editions and their pricing are quoted from docs.drone.io/enterprise and drone.io/enterprise/opensource; the closed registration of cloud.drone.io is quoted from the vendor's support forum, the newest first-party statement found
